text.tspan: Like a lily in sun’s warm light
Lord, renew all our inner being;
Make us single, pure and true;
By Your life within still work
And make our spirit whole for You.
In Your love, in Your presence, Lord,
Keep us close to You each day;
Lord, guide us in Your way.
We set our mind on Your intention,
Join You in life as one;
As lilies in Your shining light,
Clothed with Your grace and love,
To the image of God’s dear Son.
